sloka: भ्रातृव्यसनसन्तप्तस्तथा देवान्तको बली।आदाय परिघं दीप्तमङ्गदं समभिद्रवत् ।। ६.७०.३ ।।
transliteration: bhrātṛvyasanasantaptastathā devāntako balī।ādāya parighaṁ dīptamaṅgadaṁ samabhidravat ।। 6.70.3 ।।

translations.english: Then, powerful Devanthaka who was immersed in grief of his brother, taking hold of a glowing iron bar rushed forward towards Angada.
